name: vibeseo-local-seo
description: A local SEO workflow for the VibeSEO connector: city keywords, local competitors, service-and-city pages and a Google Business Profile checklist turned into a prioritized plan.

interface.longDescription:
Plan local SEO for a business that serves customers in specific cities, grounded in your own data: what people search for your services in each city and how often, which local competitors keep showing up, which service-and-city pages your site has or is missing, and how to fix titles and headings for local searches. It ends with a checklist for your Google Business Profile and business listings, and a list of next actions ranked by expected impact. Google Business Profile, Maps rankings and reviews are covered as guidance, not data.

Requires the VibeSEO connector ("SEO Keywords by VibeSEO"): add it in one tap at https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6a1606dfad8c819190800c65ba5b56c4 and sign in. You also need a VibeSEO project for your site.
defaultPrompt: Plan local SEO for my business in my city.
Which "near me" and city keywords should my site target?
Which city pages is my site missing compared to competitors?

publication.release_notes: Initial release: a guided local SEO plan over the VibeSEO connector.
